Your privacy matters to us. Here's how Foodly collects, uses, and protects your information.

Your trust is our priority. At Foodly, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This policy outlines how we handle your information with total transparency when you visit our website, make a reservation, or contact us.
To provide a seamless experience, we collect only what is necessary:
Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and any other details you voluntarily provide when you make a reservation, contact us, or subscribe to updates.
Reservation Details: Preferred date, time, and number of guests submitted through our reservation form.
Automatically Collected Information: Technical details such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and time spent on our site through cookies and similar technologies.
Communication Data: Records of communications via email, phone, or contact form to respond to inquiries and improve our service.
We use your information to elevate your experience:
Responding to inquiries, questions, or feedback.
Sending updates, promotions, or newsletters (if you have opted in).
Improving our website's functionality, design, and content.
Maintaining the security and proper operation of our website.
Complying with legal obligations where required.
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and understand our visitors. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings.

We may use trusted third-party services (such as reservation systems, analytics providers, or hosting platforms). These third parties have access to limited information strictly to perform their designated functions and are obligated not to disclose or use it for other purposes.
Security: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
Retention: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy.
Depending on your location, you have the right to:
Access the personal information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request deletion of your personal information.
Opt out of marketing communications at any time.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Our website is not directed at children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware of any, we will take immediate steps to delete it.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
